items.title: 4.3 Combining Computational Structures for Complex Problems (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of combining structures (PDF 118).

blocks.text: Pecheeda (complex) masail achhi tarah hal karne ke liye mukhtalif data structures, jaise lists, stacks, queues, trees aur graphs, ko mila kar istemal karna zaroori hai. Har structure ki apni khoobiyan hain, aur mila kar hum mushkil masail zyada kamyabi se hal kar sakte hain.

Is milap se zyada mazboot aur efficient hal bante hain. Yeh data ke pecheeda rishte sambhalne aur masle hal karne ki salahiyat barhane mein madad deta hai. In structures ko saath istemal kar ke hum aise hal bana sakte hain jo khaas zaroorat ke mutabiq hon, aur program ki raftaar (performance) aur kaam (functionality) dono behtar hon.

blocks.prompt: Mez (desk) ko tarteeb dene ka kaam sochiye. Stack aur queue dono kaise madad kar sakte hain (long question 8)?
blocks.explanation: Kaam (kaghaz tarteeb dena, kitabein rakhna, mez saaf karna) queue mein rakhein taake mansoobe ki tarteeb se hon. Kaghaz stack ki tarah jama hote hain: sab se oopar, yaani aakhir mein rakha kaghaz, pehle utha kar file hota hai; kitabein bhi dher bana kar oopar se rakhi jati hain. Queue kaamon ki tarteeb tay karti hai; stack har kaam ke andar ki cheezein sambhalta hai.

items: Structures mila kar har ek ki khoobi pecheeda masail mein kaam aati hai.
